reuse.why: The tree already has getDateWithWeekendRule as the single weekend definition, but the daily rule is written inline in getNextDate rather than extending that definition.

duplication.why: The skip/weekend condition (skipWeekend && !noSkipWeekend && isWeekend) is re-expressed inline next to the existing rule, and the inner loop repeats the occurrence/isWeekend check it does just above.

placement.why: The weekend rule is a special-case branch inside getNextDate instead of in the shared getDateWithWeekendRule that getUpcomingDates and the schedule template also call.

scope.why: Only getNextDate and its tests are touched.

maintainability.why: The weekend rule now lives in two places, with getUpcomingDates and the schedule template still moving daily weekend occurrences, and the hard-coded two-iteration loop is opaque.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts getNextDate: daily weekend skipping decided inline before and around getDateWithWeekendRule rather than inside it.

disguised_duplication.where: getNextDate re-tests skipWeekend && !noSkipWeekend && d.isWeekend inline, the same condition getDateWithWeekendRule already decides, reshaped as a skip loop.

one_place.where: Daily rule only in getNextDate (shared/schedules.ts); getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and createScheduleList in server/budget/schedule-template.ts still apply getDateWithWeekendRule's move behaviour to daily schedules.
